standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome to my private little wyvern area.

steps.npc: I'm Pieve. My big brother Steve made this training area, but he's gone off to be a Slayer Master to replace our cousin Nieve, so this area's mine now.

options.text: Why is this wyvern area private?

steps.player: Why is this wyvern area private?

steps.npc: My brother, Steve, carved the steps to get up here. He was jealous of our cousin, Nieve, because she'd got a huge training cave where she could boss people around. So he made this place.

options.text: So are you a Slayer Master?

steps.player: So are you a Slayer Master?

steps.npc: No, I'm not. My brother Steve is a Slayer Master. He took over the job from our cousin Nieve. All he has to do is tell people to kill stuff - he says it's easy!

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: That's not your assigned Slayer target. Up here, I expect people to focus on their Slayer training.
